I'm a data science leader with a mix of experience in statistics, machine learning, healthcare strategy, operations, finance, and clinical research. I lead a team of four data scientists and stay hands-on as a player-coach: I set direction, mentor the team, and turn technically demanding work into clear, useful decisions.

My core work is forecasting, causal inference, classification, and decision support in large healthcare systems. I'm extending it into modern AI and machine learning, and the projects on this site are where that shows up.
